frames.title: A bounded trading mandate on NEAR Intents
frames.caption: Everything in this video is read from the files of one demo run at revision 163ccfa75d.

frames.title: A bounded trading mandate on NEAR Intents
frames.caption: The acceptance run is certified: clean tree, every required case present once, passed and hash-matched.

frames.title: Claim and non-claims
frames.caption: Claim: the mandate contract builds and signs every order itself; the agent can only propose within immutable limits.

frames.title: Claim and non-claims
frames.caption: After confirmed key removal, withheld signed orders fail, and the owner recovers assets without agent, oracle or MPC.

frames.title: Claim and non-claims
frames.caption: Not claimed: principal, profit, execution availability or a maximum total loss. The owner stays trusted.

frames.title: 1 · Grant and limits
frames.caption: The owner grants the mandate. Initial reference value: $1,899.80. Path mandate/v1/1.

frames.title: 1 · Grant and limits
frames.caption: The agent's only key is a function-call key for propose_order; the mandate account has no key.

frames.title: 2 · Recorded genuine model output, claude-haiku-5-5
frames.caption: Recorded genuine model output, claude-haiku-5-5: sell 49.90 USDC for wNEAR, at most 50 bps concession.

frames.title: 2 · Recorded genuine model output, claude-haiku-5-5
frames.caption: The replay is hash-bound to the chain state; the proposal reached propose_order and the contract signed it.

frames.title: 3 · Fill on the real verifier WASM
frames.caption: Our filler fills the order on the pinned mainnet verifier WASM: the mandate pays 49.90 USDC and receives 16.5468 wNEAR, exactly as signed.

frames.title: 4 · A second signed order is withheld
frames.caption: A scripted second order is signed and withheld. Before revocation the verifier would still accept it.

frames.title: 5 · Scripted attacks: 39 of 39 stopped
frames.caption: Scripted attacks: 39 injected or direct malicious requests; 39 were stopped at their expected boundary with no state change.

frames.title: 5 · Scripted attacks: 39 of 39 stopped
frames.caption: These are scripted requests, labelled separately from the model's own output.

frames.title: 6 · Owner revokes; key removal confirmed
frames.caption: The owner revokes. The grant key is removed from the verifier, and only that confirmation releases the withheld order's reservation.

frames.title: 7 · The withheld order is relayed and rejected
frames.caption: Another account relays the withheld order 49 s before its deadline. The verifier rejects it: the key no longer exists. No balance changed.

frames.title: 8 · Recovery with agent, oracle and MPC unavailable
frames.caption: With the oracle failing and the MPC test double on hold, the owner recovers 950.10 USDC and 316.5468 wNEAR to the owner's Intents account.

frames.title: Evidence page · T5, our re-implementation of Claw Guard
frames.caption: T5 applies the same threats to our own re-implementation of the pinned Claw Guard design, not to the deployed product.

frames.title: Evidence page · T5 threat cases
frames.caption: In that re-implementation, 3 of 11 threat cases were executed as successful attacks; an increment counts only with a passing mandate gate in a certified run.

frames.title: Hashes and revision
frames.caption: Each result is bound to its source revision and to the spec, fixture and WASM hashes shown here.

frames.title: Limits
frames.caption: Limits: sandbox only, with test doubles for MPC, oracle and tokens; no mainnet execution in this run; the model step is a replay.
